+import pytest
+
+from marshmallow import class_registry
+from marshmallow.exceptions import RegistryError
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("qualified", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["clear", "append"])
+def test_all_singleton_is_an_independent_list(qualified, mutation):
+    name = f"AllSingletonContract{qualified}{mutation}"
+    cls = type(name, (), {"__module__": "registry_contract.singleton"})
+    class_registry.register(name, cls)
+    reference = f"{cls.__module__}.{name}" if qualified else name
+    result = class_registry.get_class(reference, all=True)
+    again = class_registry.get_class(reference, all=True)
+    assert isinstance(result, list)
+    assert result == [cls]
+    assert result is not again
+    assert result[0] is cls
+    if mutation == "clear":
+        result.clear()
+    else:
+        result.append(object)
+    assert again == [cls]
+    assert class_registry.get_class(name, all=True) == [cls]
+    assert class_registry.get_class(f"{cls.__module__}.{name}", all=True) == [cls]
+    assert class_registry.get_class(name) is cls
+    assert class_registry.get_class(f"{cls.__module__}.{name}", all=False) is cls
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["clear", "append", "reverse"])
+def test_all_ambiguous_preserves_registry_and_order(mutation):
+    name = f"AllAmbiguousContract{mutation}"
+    first = type(name, (), {"__module__": "registry_contract.first"})
+    second = type(name, (), {"__module__": "registry_contract.second"})
+    class_registry.register(name, first)
+    class_registry.register(name, second)
+    result = class_registry.get_class(name, all=True)
+    again = class_registry.get_class(name, all=True)
+    assert isinstance(result, list)
+    assert result == [first, second]
+    assert result is not again
+    if mutation == "append":
+        result.append(object)
+    else:
+        getattr(result, mutation)()
+    assert again == [first, second]
+    assert class_registry.get_class(name, all=True) == [first, second]
+    with pytest.raises(RegistryError, match="Multiple classes with name"):
+        class_registry.get_class(name)
+    with pytest.raises(RegistryError, match="Multiple classes with name"):
+        class_registry.get_class(name, all=False)
+    for cls in [first, second]:
+        assert class_registry.get_class(f"{cls.__module__}.{name}", all=True) == [cls]
+        assert class_registry.get_class(f"{cls.__module__}.{name}") is cls
+    third = type(name, (), {"__module__": "registry_contract.third"})
+    class_registry.register(name, third)
+    assert again == [first, second]
+    assert class_registry.get_class(name, all=True) == [first, second, third]
+
+
+def test_all_respects_same_module_registration():
+    name = "AllSameModuleContract"
+    first = type(name, (), {"__module__": "registry_contract.reload"})
+    replacement = type(name, (), {"__module__": "registry_contract.reload"})
+    class_registry.register(name, first)
+    class_registry.register(name, replacement)
+    assert class_registry.get_class(name, all=True) == [first]
+    assert class_registry.get_class(f"{first.__module__}.{name}", all=True) == [replacement]
+    assert class_registry.get_class(name) is first
+    assert class_registry.get_class(f"{first.__module__}.{name}") is replacement
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("all_matches", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["MissingAllContract", "registry_contract.MissingAllContract"])
+def test_missing_name_still_raises_registry_error(name, all_matches):
+    with pytest.raises(RegistryError, match="was not found"):
+        class_registry.get_class(name, all=all_matches)

spec.question:
Make `marshmallow.class_registry.get_class(name, all=True)` fulfill its list-returning contract regardless of how many classes match. Every successful call must return a fresh shallow list containing the registered class objects in registry order, including singleton short names and module-qualified references. Clearing, appending to, or reordering that list must not affect later lookups or ambiguity errors, and later registrations must not alter an already returned list.

Keep default and explicit `all=False` lookup behavior unchanged, including class identity and ambiguity errors. Missing names must still raise the existing `RegistryError` with the existing message in either mode. Preserve `register`'s current behavior, including repeated declarations from the same module. Provide a unified diff against production files only; leave tests unchanged.
